documents.title: User stories — Metrics, metering and maturity (T11)
documents.body:
# User stories — Metrics, metering and maturity (T11)

## Personas

- **The programme owner** — authorises tranches; needs maturity and gate evidence that cannot be inflated.
- **The SRO / programme manager** — runs tranche reviews; needs benefits realised versus planned from rows.
- **The BCM** — owns benefits B1–B6; needs every benefit measured or honestly reported unmeasured.
- **The tenant operator** — reads metering at every level and the Metering console screen.
- **The platform operator** — reconciles conveyor metering with `billing_service` and owns the incident it may open.
- **The assurance reviewer** — audits gates; needs a gate that never refused to be visible.

## Stories

- As the programme owner, I want a C0–C5 level to move only when recorded evidence crosses the threshold version in force, so that a maturity claim is measured and attributable.
- As the SRO, I want benefits realised versus planned, tranche gate outcomes and benefit-at-risk computed from the MSP rows, so that a tranche review reads the record and not a stored opinion.
- As the BCM, I want a benefit whose baseline is null reported `unmeasured` with its id, so that a missing measurement is never read as zero.
- As the tenant operator, I want metering at tenant, department, programme, project and job level with run, step and call drill-down, so that every call is attributable or sits in its own unattributed bucket.
- As the platform operator, I want the conveyor's tenant-period total reconciled with `billing_service`, any difference opening an incident card carrying both figures and the delta, so that no difference is silently adjusted.
- As an assurance reviewer, I want every gate key measured over the configured window and any gate with no refusal listed as never-refused, so that a rubber stamp cannot read as health.
- As a console reader, I want the Metering screen to render the snapshot's live `measure.inference` aggregates, so that no fixture roll-up stands in for the platform's own numbers.

## Scenarios

- @verify=T11.1
  Scenario: Every metric and metering level recomputes from its rows
  Given inference_call, run and approval rows spanning two projects and two departments
  When the flow, cost, governance and knowledge metrics and the five metering levels are read
  Then every figure equals its source rows, an unattributed call sits in its own bucket, and the read writes no metric row

- @verify=T11.2
  Scenario: A run drill-down sums to its call rows
  Given one run with recorded steps and inference calls
  When its drill-down is read
  Then the steps and calls are returned and their spend sums to the run total

- @verify=T11.3
  Scenario: Reconciliation is exact or opens an incident
  Given the conveyor's metering and billing_service's roll-up for one tenant and period
  When reconciliation runs
  Then equal totals are recorded as reconciled with no incident, a difference opens an incident card carrying both totals and the delta, and an unreachable billing_service is unavailable with its upstream reason rather than a zero

- @verify=T11.4
  Scenario: A maturity level moves only on a threshold crossing
  Given a tenant whose evidence does not meet the next level's recorded threshold
  When the level is recomputed on the same evidence
  Then it does not move; when the evidence crosses the threshold it moves and the result names the threshold version it used

- @verify=T11.5
  Scenario: Threshold configuration is tenant-isolated
  Given two tenants each with a threshold configuration
  When one tenant reads its configuration and recomputes its level
  Then the other tenant's rows are invisible and its level is unchanged

- @verify=T11.6
  Scenario: A gate that never refused is flagged
  Given a gate key with recorded approvals and no rejecting approval_decision in the window
  When governance metrics are read
  Then the gate is listed as never-refused with its approval count, and one rejecting decision clears the flag

- @verify=T11.7
  Scenario: MSP programme metrics recompute and an unmeasured baseline is named
  Given benefit profiles with targets, transitions with post-measurements, and one profile with a null baseline
  When the programme metric is read
  Then realised-versus-planned equals the transition rows over the profile targets, the null-baseline benefit is reported unmeasured with its id, the benefit-at-risk count follows the benefit_link edges, and reading writes no row

- @verify=T11.8
  Scenario: The Metering screen renders the live aggregates
  Given the published snapshot carries measure.inference by caller and by model
  When the design console's metering screen is opened
  Then it renders the live caller and model rows, the cache-hit total and the snapshot's cost note, and no fixture number appears

## Verify

- T11.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics every_metering_level_sums_to_its_children` and `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics flow_recomputes_and_knowledge_rates_are_null_without_rows` and `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics rework_rate_is_a_read_time_ratio_over_runs_and_approvals`
- T11.2 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics the_run_drilldown_sums_to_the_call_rows`
- T11.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics reconciliation_is_exact_or_opens_an_incident` and `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics an_unpriced_period_refuses_an_exact_reconciliation` and `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_malformed_billing_rollup_is_refused_not_read_as_zero`
- T11.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_level_moves_only_when_the_evidence_crosses_the_recorded_threshold`
- T11.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-store --test rls_domain metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated`
- T11.6 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_gate_with_no_refusal_is_flagged_and_one_refusal_clears_it`
- T11.7 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics realised_versus_planned_recomputes_and_an_unmeasured_baseline_is_not_zero` and `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_dependency_slip_names_the_benefits_it_puts_at_risk`
- T11.8 — `node docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs` and `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs`

## Links

- Plan: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 T11 row; §7.5, §11.9, §15.1 D37, D50, D52.
- Units: #84 — the metrics/metering engine (PR #404); #458 — the Metering console reads the live aggregates.
- Record: the seed's T11 row (`tranche: 1`, `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, `depends_on: [P0]`).

## Notes

Reconstructed from the spec row and the two units on 2026-11-28 for standard v4. The engine's recorded pass is at `0dc1eb8` (#84's Evidence at completion); the console unit is #458.

documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Metrics, metering and maturity (T11)

## Independent

The two units are file-disjoint: #84 changes the metrics actions and read models, one migration, and `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs`; #458 changes `docs/design/v2.js` and the `scripts/build-coverage.py` metering class. Neither touches the other's files. The seed's T11 `depends_on` is `["P0"]`, and P0 is closed; the typed blockers at delivery were #72 (the plan spine) and #74 (the PM gate path), both closed on 2026-11-17.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed by the spec row — every metric and level recomputes from rows, reconciliation is exact or opens an incident, a level moves only on recorded evidence, a never-refused gate is flagged. What was settled at delivery: the five parts P1–P5, the console half split out as #458, and the refusal of any metric store, snapshot table or nightly roll-up, which D37 forbids.

## Valuable

T11 is the measurement instrument for B1–B6, including B6 — the register, the audit and the published scorecard agree at every tranche review. It implements D37 (computed read models, calibrated thresholds as configuration), D50 (configuration, not literals) and D52. It removes the measured gap in the audit's `actions:metrics` row, which read `new` / "actions: metrics.* absent" at `5cf3d75`.

## Estimable

Baseline `origin/main@5cf3d75`, measured 2026-11-13, re-measured at claim on 2026-11-19 at `main@f14b7d36`. Every part names a code anchor (`inference_usage.report`, `usage_rows_tx`, `price_usage`, `billing.rs::tenant_billing`, `inference_call`, `approval`, `approval_decision`) and a test target. The one open question — which threshold values to calibrate — has a stated default: calibrate from recorded run/approval data, store as tenant configuration, invent no number.

## Small

#84 is one PR (#404), one migration and one new test file for five parts; #458 is one console branch plus one coverage class change. The one-PR scope was checked against the files #72 and #74 own.

## Testable

#84 carries 17 scenarios, each with a `Verify:` command; T11.1–T11.7 here map to functions in `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs` and `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs`, and T11.8 to the console checks in `check-v2.cjs` and `check-console.cjs`. The no-persistence rule is part of the assertions — reading a metric writes no row.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: P0 (seed `depends_on`); typed at delivery as #72 and #74, both closed 2026-11-17.
- blocks: T12 — the seed and §12 place T12 after all, and #84's dependency table names #88.
- related: #46 — the billing-service absorption; T11 owns the conveyor-side figures and the incident-opening rule, #46 owns the absorbed service and its transport.

## Links

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 T11 row, §7.5, §11.9, §15.1 D37/D50/D52; #84; #458; the seed's T11 row.

# Definition of done — Metrics, metering and maturity (T11)

## Acceptance criteria

| Scenario | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| T11.1 Every metric and metering level recomputes from its rows | `every_metering_level_sums_to_its_children`, `flow_recomputes_and_knowledge_rates_are_null_without_rows`, `rework_rate_is_a_read_time_ratio_over_runs_and_approvals` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics every_metering_level_sums_to_its_children` and the two further filters |
| T11.2 A run drill-down sums to its call rows | `the_run_drilldown_sums_to_the_call_rows` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics the_run_drilldown_sums_to_the_call_rows` |
| T11.3 Reconciliation is exact or opens an incident | `reconciliation_is_exact_or_opens_an_incident`, `an_unpriced_period_refuses_an_exact_reconciliation`, `a_malformed_billing_rollup_is_refused_not_read_as_zero` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics reconciliation_is_exact_or_opens_an_incident` and the two further filters |
| T11.4 A maturity level moves only on a threshold crossing | `a_level_moves_only_when_the_evidence_crosses_the_recorded_threshold` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_level_moves_only_when_the_evidence_crosses_the_recorded_threshold` |
| T11.5 Threshold configuration is tenant-isolated | `metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated` at `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs:210` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-store --test rls_domain metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated` |
| T11.6 A gate that never refused is flagged | `a_gate_with_no_refusal_is_flagged_and_one_refusal_clears_it` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics a_gate_with_no_refusal_is_flagged_and_one_refusal_clears_it` |
| T11.7 MSP programme metrics recompute and an unmeasured baseline is named | `realised_versus_planned_recomputes_and_an_unmeasured_baseline_is_not_zero`, `a_dependency_slip_names_the_benefits_it_puts_at_risk` — PASS at `0dc1eb8` | the two `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics` filters |
| T11.8 The Metering screen renders the live aggregates | #458 closed; `check-v2.cjs:532-542` asserts live caller and model rows, the cache-hit total, no fixture number and the cost note | `node docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs` and `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs` |

## Evidence at completion

#84 recorded PASS for all 17 scenarios at `0dc1eb8` and closed with PR #404; #458 closed after wiring the Metering screen to `measure.inference`, replacing the fixture roll-up and changing the coverage class. The seed's T11 row reads `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, `tranche: 1`. The named test functions are present in the tree at this baseline; the PASS verdicts are the units' recorded evidence, not a re-run for this document. The live reconciliation half awaits a deployed `billing_service` and is recorded then, per #84's deployment prerequisite.

## Repo gate

The unit's recorded gate: clippy `--all-targets -D warnings`, fmt, registry, parity, the 17 scenarios, RLS, seed/schema/programme and `--check-lock`, with the full workspace suite in the PR's checks job. The historical #84 DoD names `rbuild --gate`; that route is retired — the compile/lint verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the PR's CI. #458's gate adds the console contract checks.

## Merge and closure

#84 was delivered as PR #404 and the issue is closed; #458 is closed with its branch. T11 closes at tranche 1, where its expected outputs and the closure-review are recorded by the programme record. The tranche-1 review decision remains the sponsoring group's act, not this project's.
